say:1:1331035201:0.text: The princess didn't just dance with anyone!
say:1:1331035201:0.source_cn: 哪有这么容易，她可是白山公国的公主！
say:1:1331035201:0.male: The princess didn't just dance with anyone!
say:1:1331035201:0.female: The princess didn't just dance with anyone!

say:2:1331035202:0.text: She didn't attend the Snowspire Festival of the previous years due to health reasons.
say:2:1331035202:0.source_cn: 前几年的冬日祭典，大公都说公主身体不好不能来参加。
say:2:1331035202:0.male: She didn't attend the Snowspire Festival of the previous years due to health reasons.
say:2:1331035202:0.female: She didn't attend the Snowspire Festival of the previous years due to health reasons.

say:3:1331035203:0.text: This year, the princess finally showed up, but I got so caught up arguing with Pelan that I had no time to dance!
say:3:1331035203:0.source_cn: 这次好不容易公主出现了，皮陆斯那家伙却一直在和我斗嘴，...
say:3:1331035203:0.male: This year, the princess finally showed up, but I got so caught up arguing with Pelan that I had no time to dance!
say:3:1331035203:0.female: This year, the princess finally showed up, but I got so caught up arguing with Pelan that I had no time to dance!

say:4:1331035204:0.text: Who would have thought the princess would pass away at such a young age...
say:4:1331035204:0.source_cn: 谁能想到公主年纪轻轻就去世，唉……
say:4:1331035204:0.male: Who would have thought the princess would pass away at such a young age...
say:4:1331035204:0.female: Who would have thought the princess would pass away at such a young age...
